description: This Java class defines the LessThan comparison operator used in the OpenMRS logic framework. It implements the ComparisonOperator interface and provides a string representation for the operator.

classes.name: LessThan
classes.description: A class representing the 'less than' comparison operator, implementing the ComparisonOperator interface.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string 'LESS THAN' as the textual representation of this operator.
